title: Loading Autechre's public 2008 Machinedrum backup (organic tutorial)

brief.idea: Organic, tutorial-style: loading Autechre's public Quaristice-tour SysEx (the Machinedrum backup of 1 March 2008, released free on their store in 2018) into the Machinedrum Editor and playing it. The Monomachine file follows as a second post. Credit on screen and in the caption, with a link to their store. Nothing may say or suggest that Autechre, Warp or Elektron endorse, use or know of the editors.
openQuestions: Decided by Radek 2026-10-06: goes ahead with credit + store link; no contact with Warp. Organic posts only: never boosted, never in a paid ad, never on the landing page.
Tempo comes from their pattern (not 120): measure it, set music.bpm and downbeat with scripts/onsets.mjs.
The import shots use inSeconds (before PLAY).
Confirm the store URL to credit (autechre.ws is assumed; the 2018 release was a hidden link on their store) before any post.
